text: Caffè Carraro, the coffee roaster behind the Carraro 1927 brand, was taken over by Giuseppe Zanandrea from the founding Carraro family in 1986, per the company's own history page.
short: Caffè Carraro was taken over by Giuseppe Zanandrea in 1986.

source.name: Caffè Carraro: Our story (history page)
source.quote: Giuseppe Zanandrea takes over from the Carraro family
source.note: The timeline entry is dated '1986'. The same site's bar-owner page lists Caffè Carraro S.p.A. (P.IVA 01845560240).
